subject: Silverline Health — proposed hybrid rate and one-time onboarding credit
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@silverlinehealth.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@silverlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot pricing — request for pilot rate and onboarding credit

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the model routing options. We’re a small but fast-moving POC group and have two asks to get internal procurement comfortable: a one-time onboarding credit to offset integration costs, and a reduced per-token rate for the first 6 months of the pilot (we expect ~200M tokens/month during that window).

Do you have flexibility on a $20k onboarding credit plus a 35% discount off list for the pilot period? If we can get those terms, we can commit to a follow-on enterprise contract covering 24 months and higher committed capacity.

Attached is a short scoping doc that outlines expected usage and timelines. Can you loop in pricing and legal as needed?

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations — Silverline Health
--
Attachment: Silverline_Scope.pdf (application/pdf)
From: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot pricing — request for pilot rate and onboarding credit

Team — forwarding Silverline's ask. Quick summary:
- Customer requests $20k one-time onboarding credit + 35% off list for first 6 months of pilot (~200M tokens/mo).
- Pilot converts to 24mo follow-on with committed capacity if we meet these terms.
- ARR upside in year 1 estimated at $1.2M ARR if they convert. See attached ARR-breakdown-06-27.xlsx and Silverline_Proposed_Terms_v1.pdf.

Ask: need pricing signoff for a commercial exception (one-time credit + deeper pilot discount). If we approve, legal will push a short MOU and DocuSign. Suggested options below — please reply with preferred path and final approver (VP or CFO).

Option A (Conservative): $10k onboarding credit + 25% pilot discount, convert-to-rate guardrails (caps on token tiers). No additional margin guarantee.
Option B (Growth): $20k onboarding credit + 30% pilot discount, with an explicit conversion commitment (24 months) and minimum ARR target to trigger the discount for pilot. Requires VP signoff.
Option C (Accelerate): $20k onboarding credit + 35% pilot discount, plus a marketing co-sell clause. Requires CFO signoff.

I recommend Option B given conversion likelihood and engineering effort required for integration.

--
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot pricing — request for pilot rate and onboarding credit

Priya — quick thoughts:
- I agree Option B as primary. 30% pilot discount sounds reasonable if they lock into 24 months at conversion; we should include a minimum monthly committed floor post-conversion (e.g., 500M tokens/month) to protect economics.
- $20k onboarding credit ok if we budget it against the new business pipeline (Finance to track as marketing/onboarding spend).

Marissa — any objections if we route to VP approval instead of CFO for faster turnaround? If so, we'll need to document the conversion triggers clearly.

Ben
VP, Enterprise Sales
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot pricing — request for pilot rate and onboarding credit

Team — thanks for the breakdown. I reviewed the ARR sheet and the conversion assumption. Two quick constraints from finance:
1) One-time onboarding credits should not exceed 2% of expected 12-month ARR unless CFO approves. For their projected conversion, $20k is borderline but not automatic.
2) Deeper pilot discounts (>=30%) need explicit conversion guardrails and a clawback if they don't convert to the committed floor within 9 months.

Proposal to expedite: approve Option B (30% + $20k) conditionally, with the following clauses to include in the MOU and SOW:
- 24-month conversion commitment with minimum committed token floor of 500M tokens/month after conversion.
- If conversion does not occur within 9 months of pilot end, the onboarding credit is recouped pro rata from final invoice or offset against support fees.
- Marketing co-sell is optional and will be approved by Partnerships separately.

I can sign off as VP if Ben documents the conversion guardrails in the MOU and Legal adds the clawback. If Finance needs to move to CFO signoff, I'll escalate.

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance — Commercial Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
To: Samira Khan <samira@silverlinehealth.com>, procurement@silverlinehealth.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot pricing — request for pilot rate and onboarding credit

Hi Samira — thanks, and great news: we can move forward on a conditional agreement. Summary of approved commercial terms for the pilot: 
- One-time onboarding credit: $20,000, subject to clawback if conversion doesn't happen within 9 months post-pilot.
- Pilot rate: 30% off list for the first 6 months, capped at 200M tokens/month for discounted pricing.
- Conversion: upon conversion to a committed 24-month enterprise contract, minimum committed floor of 500M tokens/month will apply; detailed tiers will be in the MOU.

Next steps: we’ll send a short MOU and SOW via DocuSign (legal will include the clawback language). Please confirm you’re OK with the conditional clawback and the capped discounted token tier so we can issue the DocuSign.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
